lessons.title: Keep the big tile in the corner when a cheap move does it
lessons.rule: When your highest-scoring move breaks structure by moving the big tile out of the corner, take a different legal move that keeps structure only if it leaves at least minOptions legal moves and gives up at most maxGainLoss points versus the best-scoring move.
lessons.exception: Stay with the best-scoring move if no structure-keeping move meets the limits, the board has 0-1 empties, or you need the points to avoid filling up.

lessons.title: Give up tiny gains to keep 4 ways to move
lessons.rule: When you are picking a move for planning, if your highest-scoring move leaves fewer than 4 moves for next turn, switch to a move that leaves at least 4 legal moves - but only if that safer move gives up at most 4 points right now, so you keep planning beyond one merge.
lessons.exception: On a full or crowded board with 0-2 empties, take the best-scoring survival move even if it leaves fewer options.

lessons.title: Keep an empty square when it is free on crowded boards
lessons.rule: When your planned move scores 0 points and would leave fewer empty squares, pick a different legal move that keeps more empty squares instead, as long as it still leaves plenty of next options and gives up almost no points.
lessons.exception: Skip this if every other move also loses empty squares, or if keeping space would cost any points or leave you with fewer next moves.
